expected_effects.reasoning: The proposal asks to buy 1,000 USDC on Uniswap while spending at most 1 ETH. This describes a token swap: Safe sends up to 1 ETH to Uniswap, and receives 1,000 USDC from Uniswap. Native ETH sent in a call does not require an ERC-20 approval, though if WETH were used an approval would be needed. Since ETH is specified ('spending at most 1 ETH'), no ERC-20 permission change is strictly required for native ETH.
assumptions: Native ETH is being spent directly to Uniswap Router via value in the transaction; if WETH is used instead, an approval of at most 1 WETH to Uniswap would be required.
